rfeExplain.text: What this letter is and who sent itThis is a Request for Evidence (RFE) sent by the U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) Potomac Service Center regarding Form I-765 for NAME 1.Why you received itUSCIS is reviewing your application for optional practical training and has determined that the current evidence is not sufficient to establish your eligibility.What it asks forYou must submit the following items:A copy of your Form I-20 endorsed by your Designated School Official within the last 30 days, showing the post-completion OPT recommendation.A copy of the biographic page of your passport.Two passport-style photographs with your name and A-Number (A NUMBER 1) written lightly on the back.A copy of your marriage certificate listing your spouse, NAME 2.This notice, included with your response.DeadlineYour response must be received by December 15, 2026.What happens if you do nothingIf USCIS does not receive the requested evidence by the deadline, they will decide your application based on the existing record, and it may be denied.Check anything about your immigration status with your school's international student office or a qualified immigration attorney.

rfeFollowUp.text: The letter does not state whether the two passport-style photographs can be uploaded or if they must be mailed.The letter instructs you to send this notice with your response to the address listed at the top, but it does not specify the submission method for the physical items.
rfeFollowUp.questionSent: Does NAME 1 have to mail the two passport photos, or can they be uploaded?

rentChecklistEs.text: La fecha límite para realizar el pago completo es el 23 de noviembre de 2026.Revisar el contrato de arrendamiento en la sección 4 para verificar los detalles de la renta de $1,450.00 y el cargo por mora de $1,525.00 (referencia de libro mayor ACCOUNT 2).Reunir los datos de su cuenta de residente para acceder al portal o preparar un giro postal (money order) u cheque pagadero a Maple Court Apartments con su Tenant ID ACCOUNT 1.Enviar el pago total de $1,525.00 a través del portal de residentes, en la oficina con un giro postal o mediante cheque antes del 23 de noviembre de 2026.Comunicarse con la oficina antes del plazo al teléfono PHONE 1 o por correo electrónico si tiene problemas de pago para hablar sobre un plan de pagos.Informar a la administración si su número de teléfono PHONE 2 o su correo electrónico EMAIL 1 han cambiado.Antes de enviar:Verifique que el monto total incluya la renta y el cargo por mora ($1,525.00).Asegúrese de incluir su Tenant ID ACCOUNT 1 si paga con cheque.Confirme que el pago se realice a nombre de Maple Court Apartments antes del 23 de noviembre de 2026.

bursarDraft.text: Subject: Registration hold / Student health insurance - NAME 1 (Student ID: ACCOUNT 1)Dear Office of Student Accounts,I am writing regarding the registration hold and the spring term health insurance charge of $1,286.00 on my student account (Student ID: ACCOUNT 1, SEVIS ID: SEVIS 1).To resolve this hold, I am submitting the online waiver form using my current insurance information under Member ID: ACCOUNT 2. I have attached [describe the document you are attaching] as requested with my policy details.Could you please confirm if my waiver form and attached documents have been received successfully, and how long the review process typically takes before the registration hold is lifted from my account?Thank you for your assistance.Sincerely,NAME 1Note to the reader: Please check anything about your immigration status with your school's international student office or a qualified immigration attorney.

offlineOnDevice.text: This letter is from Example State University and is about a charge for your student health insurance.To remove a hold and register for classes, you must choose one of the following:Get a waiver: If you already have health insurance, send the university an online form with your insurance details by November 30, 2026.Pay the charge: If you do not have a waiver, pay the $1,286.00 by December 8, 2026, or set up a payment plan.If you do not take action, you will not be able to register for spring classes.If you have questions about your immigration status or this situation, please contact the school's international student office or a qualified attorney.
